question: How many customers are there?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customers

question: List all product names
gold_sql: SELECT name FROM products

question: What products cost more than 100?
gold_sql: SELECT name, price FROM products WHERE price > 100

question: Which customers are from New York?
gold_sql: SELECT name FROM customers WHERE city = 'New York'

question: What is the cheapest product?
gold_sql: SELECT name, price FROM products ORDER BY price ASC LIMIT 1

question: What is the total revenue from all orders?
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(total_amount) FROM orders

question: How many products are in the Electronics category?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM products WHERE category = 'Electronics'

question: Which customers have no email?
gold_sql: SELECT name FROM customers WHERE email IS NULL

question: Which products cost between 50 and 200?
gold_sql: SELECT name, price FROM products WHERE price BETWEEN 50 AND 200

question: Which products have 'Pro' in the name?
gold_sql: SELECT name FROM products WHERE name LIKE '%Pro%'

question: List products ordered by price from most to least expensive
gold_sql: SELECT name, price FROM products ORDER BY price DESC

question: How many products are in each category?
gold_sql: SELECT category, COUNT(*) FROM products GROUP BY category

question: Show me each customer with their order count
gold_sql: SELECT c.name, COUNT(o.order_id) FROM customers c LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id GROUP BY c.name

question: Show me orders placed by Alice Johnson
gold_sql: SELECT o.order_id, o.order_date, o.total_amount FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE c.name = 'Alice Johnson'

question: What is the average product price?
gold_sql: SELECT AVG(price) FROM products

question: Which customer has placed the most orders?
gold_sql: SELECT c.name, COUNT(o.order_id) as order_count FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id GROUP BY c.name ORDER BY order_count DESC LIMIT 1

question: Show me Electronics products that cost less than 100
gold_sql: SELECT name, price FROM products WHERE category = 'Electronics' AND price < 100

question: What are the different order statuses?
gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT status FROM orders

question: How many reviews has each product received?
gold_sql: SELECT p.name, COUNT(r.review_id) FROM products p LEFT JOIN reviews r ON p.product_id = r.product_id GROUP BY p.name

question: What is the total spending per customer?
gold_sql: SELECT c.name, SUM(o.total_amount) FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id GROUP BY c.name

question: Show me customers who have NOT placed any orders
gold_sql: SELECT c.name FROM customers c LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE o.order_id IS NULL

question: Which product categories have an average rating above 4.0?
gold_sql: SELECT p.category, AVG(r.rating) FROM products p JOIN reviews r ON p.product_id = r.product_id GROUP BY p.category HAVING AVG(r.rating) > 4.0

question: Find customers who spent more than the average order amount
gold_sql: SELECT c.name FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id GROUP BY c.name HAVING SUM(o.total_amount) > (SELECT AVG(total_amount) FROM orders)

question: Show me each order with customer name and product names
gold_sql: SELECT o.order_id, c.name, p.name FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id

question: Which product has the highest total revenue from order items?
gold_sql: SELECT p.name, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) as revenue FROM products p JOIN order_items oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id GROUP BY p.name ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 1

question: How many orders were placed in each month?
gold_sql: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', order_date) as month, COUNT(*) FROM orders GROUP BY month ORDER BY month

question: Show me customers who bought Electronics products and rated them 5 stars
gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT c.name FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id JOIN reviews r ON p.product_id = r.product_id AND c.customer_id = r.customer_id WHERE p.category = 'Electronics' AND r.rating = 5

question: Categorize products by price: cheap if under 50, medium if under 200, expensive otherwise
gold_sql: SELECT name, price, CASE WHEN price < 50 THEN 'cheap' WHEN price < 200 THEN 'medium' ELSE 'expensive' END as price_category FROM products

question: Which products are above the average price?
gold_sql: SELECT name, price FROM products WHERE price > (SELECT AVG(price) FROM products)

question: What is the average rating per product category and how many reviews does each have?
gold_sql: SELECT p.category, AVG(r.rating) as avg_rating, COUNT(r.review_id) as review_count FROM products p JOIN reviews r ON p.product_id = r.product_id GROUP BY p.category
